sub_parameters.name: Config
sub_parameters.description:
The configuration of the Nth pricing module. The value of N ranges from 1 to 50. Format: "AA:aa,BB:bb", where AA and BB are the property codes of the pricing module, and aa and bb are the corresponding property values.

> You can call the [DescribePricingModule](~~96469~~) operation to obtain the Module parameter.

sub_parameters.name: ModuleCode
sub_parameters.description:
The module code of the Nth pricing module.


> You can call the [DescribePricingModule](~~96469~~) operation to obtain the Module parameter.

sub_parameters.name: PriceType
sub_parameters.description:
The price type of the Nth pricing module. Valid values:
- Hour: hourly price.
- Usage: usage-based price.
- Month: monthly price.
- Year: yearly price.

> You can call the [DescribePricingModule](~~96469~~) operation to obtain the Module parameter.

parameters.name: Region
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: SubscriptionType
parameters.description: The subscription type. Valid values: PayAsYouGo.
